hypothesis: Strictly mature net expert feedback can improve a small SOXX-relative active sleeve versus its fixed mixture, without increasing benchmark drawdown or tail risk.
execution: Prior-close decision at 16:15 America/New_York; following canonical open execution; next-open marking; no terminal liquidation; fractional adjusted-price shares; cash yield 0; each cost owns separate positions, fees, feedback and learner state.
feedback: Expert own cost-after next-open return available at exit session 09:31 America/New_York, strictly before decision_at. Parent account has separate funded settlement; expert returns are not averaged into parent returns.
design: One fixed online candidate vs identical-schedule fixed-prior mixture; three static experts are controls. No price forecast fitting, parameter selection, regime thresholds, seed selection or post-result candidate expansion.
stopping: Keep all results. No promotion from reused history. Do not retune after outcome. A future independent experiment needs a new registered mechanism and identity.
forward_requirement: A new frozen protocol plus timestamped append-only predictions/decisions recorded before executable observations, continuous independent later outcomes, and the same risk/cost/stability gates; this historical runner cannot grant production eligibility.
limitations: All source history reused in prior research.
Snapshot is retrospectively adjusted price basis, not independently verified total-return series.
Cash zero yield; historical opening prices are not verified live broker fills.
SOXL/SOXX is an imperfect leveraged/underlying pair; no exact 3x long-horizon assumption.
Regret bounds do not imply positive alpha or future outperformance.
Rolling windows overlap and are not independent samples.
gate_definition: At both costs: aggregate positive net log excess; >=6/7 positive full signal years; median annual log excess>0; positive aggregate after removing any one year; MaxDD and CVaR5 no worse than SOXX; >=60% positive overlapping 252-session windows; 20/60-block one-sided95% lower>0, family1, seed1729. No independent forward certification.
